title: Roast Mushroom Risotto
subtitle: with Broccolini and Almonds
description: You don't need cheese or butter to create an insanely tasty vegan risotto; what you do need are these umami-rich mushrooms, roasted until tender and then stirred into creamy rice. Finish with broccolini and slivered almonds for crunch.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Trim the broccolini and halve lengthwise. Finely chop the onion. Quarter the mushrooms. Crumble 1 stock cube into a heatproof jug, add 500ml (2 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Roast veggies: Put the broccolini and mushrooms (see Make it yours) on either side of the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Scatter the almonds over the broccolini. Bake for 15 mins or until the mushrooms and broccolini are tender.

Start risotto: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3 mins or until softened. Add the rice and pepper and garlic seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the grains are well coated.

Finish risotto: Add the stock to the rice mixture, reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 15 mins or until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is almost tender. Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the roasted mushrooms and stand, covered, for 5 mins.
Serve up: Taste the risotto, then season with salt. Divide the risotto among bowls and top with the roasted broccolini and almonds. Enjoy!
Make it yours: We've roasted the mushrooms to intensify their flavour, but feel free to cook them in the risotto if you prefer. Simply add them with the stock in Step 4.
